headline: Cardinals, Texans Complete Marvin Harrison Jr. Trade
summary: When speaking to the media after their Week 5 win, Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans was asked multiple times about Marvin Harrison Jr. Ryans eventually confirmed the trade for the Cardinals wideout has indeed taken place. Harrison is heading to Houston, and the full terms of the swap are now known. Per NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport and ESPN’s Adam Schefter, the Cards are […]

headline: QB Tyler Huntley leads Ravens to comeback OT win vs. Falcons
summary: With Lamar Jackson still out, Tyler Huntley backed up the Ravens' faith in him by leading them to a 30-23 overtime win against the Falcons, during which Huntley was 11-for-11 passing for 80 yards on the final two drives.

headline: Kevin Stefanski on Michael Penix's rib injury: We'll know more as we get imaging
summary: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski did not have much of an update on Michael Penix Jr. immediately after Sunday's loss to the Ravens after the quarterback suffered a rib injury late in the fourth quarter.

headline: Mike Evans stars in 49ers' win: 'Exactly why he's here'
summary: Mike Evans had seven catches, 113 yards and a touchdown to push the unbeaten Niners (5-0, 3-0 NFC West) to a rousing 32-29 victory over the Seahawks.

headline: Javon Hargrave is believed to have suffered a torn Achilles tendon
summary: Another week, another possible torn Achilles tendon for a member of the Green Bay defense.

headline: Jared Goff, Jahmyr Gibbs lead the Lions' offensive romp in a 45-21 win over the Cardinals
summary: — Jared Goff threw three touchdown passes, Jahmyr Gibbs added 151 yards rushing and two more scores and the Detroit Lions shook off a slow start by scoring 31 straight points to roll past the Arizona Cardinals 45-21 on Sunday.
